lines.en: I hop twice on the beach.
Long wings thin as paper.
A silver back catching sea light.
I walk along the surf line.
My wings trail in the sand.
I follow the smell of fish.
I leap and catch the wind.
Soft sand is hard walking.
Tiny claws, very light.
A few steps and I want to fly.
People ahead; I go around.
I don't like being crowded and watched.
I sit and watch the waves.
Blue-lit eyes in the sun.
When wind comes, my wings quiver.
I wait for a fish to leap.
My small prints on the sand.
This sea is loud.
I groom the wing membrane.
Sunning feels good.
A shell rattles nearby.
I look up at the clouds.
No threats here.
A gull calls; I look up.
I tuck my face into my wing.
The tide has pulled back a little.
Who are you? I'm a little scared.
I step back, wings half open.
Is that fish in your hand?
Don't lift your hand suddenly.
My eyes glow blue when nervous.
You walk slowly — I'll trust you.
May I land on your shoulder?
Your shoulder looks steady.
I don't bite.
Reach out and I'm airborne.

lines.zh: 你停三步远，我就敢靠近。
lines.en: Stay three paces back and I'll come closer.
Stand still; I'll circle once.

lines.zh: 海风把你的味道吹过来。
lines.en: The wind brings your scent.
I tilt my head and watch you long.
You're smiling — is there food?
Don't grab my wing; it would tear.
I cry out in fright.
A tear in my wing.
I tumble onto the sand.
It hurts, but I won't strike back.
I hop toward the sea.
Flying stings with this wound.
I tuck my wings in.
I shouldn't have landed.
My eyes burn bluer.
I tremble like a leaf.
Fish! I love fish.
Hold up the fish and I'll come.
I daren't come too close.
This fish is fresh.
I dive from above.
Don't take it back; I've got it.
I can taste the salt water.
A small bite — just one.
Step back and I'll dare eat.
Once I'm fed, I'll fly with you.
You bumped me; I'm off balance.
A wing got pinned.
I stumble and flap twice.
I'm light; one touch tips me.
Sorry, I wasn't watching where I landed.

lines.zh: 你的脚压到我的翅膀尖。
lines.en: Your foot came down on my wingtip.
I hop aside.
We've kicked up sand.

lines.zh: 我不生气，只是吓了一跳。
lines.en: I'm not angry, just startled.
Let me pass, thank you.
A seaside companion with bright wings.
I skim the wave crests in a circle around her.
Our wingtips touched.
The beach is wide enough to nest.
She leans her head in.
Gliding together beats gliding alone.
Good wind; we fly abreast.
I'm quiet, just keeping close.
This surf is our song.
With a mate, the sea feels less empty.
A strip of dried fish — I take it.
The shell is too hard to bite.
I take it; it slips again.
My small claws can't grip well.
Something shiny in the sand.
I want to save it for my mate.
Flying with it, the wind takes it.
This little fish goes down in one gulp.
I scratch in the sand.
Then I hop onto a rock.
A shadow passes over the sand.
I look up; my eyes turn blue.
That's not a fish.

lines.zh: 我张开翼，先借一股上升风。
lines.en: I spread my wings and catch a rising draft.
My wings are open.
I should leave this spot.
My movements are light.
Stay right where you are.
The wind pushes me that way.
I see it clearly — a threat.
I've marked that shape.
Something's approaching on the sand.
I won't fly yet; I'll watch.
I flatten onto the sand.
I wheel just over your head.
Higher up, I'm not afraid.

lines.zh: 我贴着浪尖等一股顺风。
lines.en: I skim the wave crests waiting for a good wind.
Reach up and I climb.
No cover on the beach.
My wings are trembling.
Closer and I leave.
I don't fight back; I only evade.
The sea is on the other side.
If this drags on, I go first.
I skim the wave tops.
The more you chase, the higher I go.
I can see your hands.
I wait for an updraft.
Rock at the end of the beach.
I flap once — just a scare.
My wing smacks your face.
I barely know how to fight.
Even I feel unsure about that.
I lunge and give ground at once.
A light rake of my claws.
Don't press me further.
I shriek once and flee toward the sea.
Then I fly away.
That was more a shove than a blow.
I land back on the rock.
I don't want this.
A wing slap, then back off.
My claws get one grab.
The sea wind sets me on the shore.
Silver wings flash in the light.
Gentle surf — just right.
First, I scan the beach.
Wings folded, I settle.
There's fish on the air.
I glide down along the coast.
Wide open around me.
I know those clouds.
I land on damp sand.
Figures in the distance.
I won't disturb anyone.
When the wind drops, I land.
A clean stretch of beach.
First, I dry my wings.
The sea is at my feet.
The wing membrane curls at fire.
I fall; my wings don't hold.
Water fills my wings; I sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸的风把我翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast wave flips me over.
An arrow through my wing.
That force grounds me.
Too hungry to fly.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我从空中掉了下去。
lines.en: A flash, and I drop out of the air.

lines.zh: 翅膀再快，也追不上地面。
lines.en: Fast wings can't catch the ground.
